title: Report on strike at Union Brewery, Ltd.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 6/2/41）

Strike at Union Brewery Ltd., (British),
Ichang Road

The two workers detained at the Station have no
previous convictions.

The management of the U.B. Brewery when
communicated with at 11.30 a.m. Thursday Feb. 6,
stated that they did not desire to press any action
against the two men and would rather leave the matter
in the hands of the Police.

Attached is a statement made by the Assistant
Engineer Mr. Magyer who fought with the two men while
preventing their unlawful entry into the engine room
apparently with the intent to stop or damage the
machinery.

Very weak
evidence
unless lead
arrested.
Jeff. Besser
unfounded
to release

The testimony of this witness would most probably
lead to a conviction under mischief or intimidation.

The situation at the U.B. Brewery is normal with
the workers still quietly congregating outside on Ichang
Road awaiting action by the management and strike
leaders.

At 11.58 a.m. Thursday Feb. 6, F.P.S. 84 Vankoff
reported by telephone that two representatives of the
Western Branch Labour Union had called at the U.B.
Brewery with the intention of interviewing the
Management.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处 1941年2月6日）

联合啤酒有限公司（英资）罢工，
宜昌路

在警局拘留的两名工人无前科。

1941年2月6日（星期四）上午11时30分与友邦啤酒厂管理层联系时，该厂表示不希望对这两人采取任何行动，而宁愿将此事交由警方处理。

随函附上助理工程师 Magyer 先生所作的陈述，他在阻止两人非法进入引擎室时与二人发生打斗，二人显然意图停止或损坏机器。

该证人的证词极有可能导致以恶意破坏或恐吓罪名定罪。

友邦啤酒厂的局势正常，工人们仍安静地聚集在宜昌路外，等待管理层和罢工领导人采取行动。

1941年2月6日（星期四）上午11时58分，外国巡捕 84 号 Vankoff 电话报告称，西部工会的两名代表已前往友邦啤酒厂，意图会见管理层。

page_data.en:
Misc. 36/41          Footoo Road

2 (Sheet 2)

The management informed Footoo Road Station over
telephone that they had no desire to interview them.
The two representatives namely,
1. Wong Ko Chun    (王可均), 26, Ningpo,
2. Zung Ping       (陳萍  ), 24, Soochow,
were invited to Footoo Road Station accompanied by
D.S. Turner on the instructions of the undersigned when
they stated that it was their intention to put before
the Management the following four demands,
1. Re-instatement of dismissed workers,
2. No unreasonable dismissal of workers,
3. Payment of wages during the period of strike,
4. Acknowledgement of the Workers' Union.
At about 2.15 p.m. a report was received from the
Management that a poster had been placed on the
factory wall by the strikers. The poster called upon
the workers to unite in order to secure a settlement
of the demands.
Copy to Special Branch,
Industrial Section, S.M.C.

                                  A.G. Tullis
                                  D. S. I.

D.D.O. "B"

/Kao
page_data.zh:
杂项 36/41          普陀路

2（第2页）

管理层通过电话告知普陀路警局，他们无意会见这两人。这两名代表即：
1. Wong Ko Chun    (王可均)，26岁，宁波人，
2. Zung Ping       (陳萍  )，24岁，苏州人，
经下述签署人指示，由警佐 Turner 陪同被邀请至普陀路警局，当时他们表示打算向管理层提出以下四项要求：
1. 复职被解雇的工人，
2. 不得无理解雇工人，
3. 支付罢工期间的工资，
4. 承认工会。
下午约2时15分，收到管理层报告，称罢工者在工厂墙上张贴了一张海报。该海报呼吁工人团结起来，以确保各项要求得到解决。
抄送：特别处，
工务局工业科。

                                  A.G. Tullis
                                  副督察长

"B"区副总监

/Kao
